_README: THE MONTHLY ROLL LIST. Edit this file when the contract months
change, hand it to the traders, and they double-click ADD-PAIRS.BAT.
The new pairs appear on their Exchanges page.
It only ADDS. It never deletes a pair, never disables one, never
touches an account, and never edits a pair that is already there -
so running it on a machine holding a position cannot move that
position's ladder out from under it. A pair already present is
reported as already present and left exactly as it is.
Symbols are the LIQUIDITY PROVIDER's spelling, and both parts
change: the suffix (XAUUSD.f, XAUUSD_, GOLD) and the contract code
(GCZ6, GC1226). Copy them from Market Watch rather than typing
from memory - a symbol the terminal does not have cannot trade, and
the pair sits there reading unknown.
leg_a_account and leg_b_account must match the account NAMES in
config.json. The wizard writes 'Account A' and 'Account B'; a
machine set up by hand may use something else, and the script will
say so rather than guess.
pair_type: SPOT_FUTURE (spot vs its own future), FUTURE_FUTURE (two
contract months), RELATED (two different instruments, NO fair
value). Getting it wrong is not cosmetic.
